newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Oman-India subsea natural gas pipeline project has not been abandoned, the chairman of the Gas Authority of India Ltd said.
- Hundreds of Iraqi merchants flush with cash are flocking to Dubai to ship food, medicine and other goods, trading sources and Dubai officials said.

- NICO Middle East, the fabrication, ship repair and offshore services group, has announced orders worth $15 million including work in progress at ADYARD Abu Dhabi LLC and its Dubai operations as they enter the 1997 financial year.
